forbidden.title: You do not have access to this section
forbidden.body: This section needs this permission: | This section needs one of these permissions:

dashboard.helloBody: Pick a section on the left or use a shortcut below. Only sections your account may open are shown.

descriptions.problems: Edit statements, translations, editorials and test data; clone a problem.
descriptions.problemImport: Upload a Polygon .zip package and follow the import progress.
descriptions.commentReports: Review reported comments, resolve or dismiss the reports.
descriptions.comments: Search every comment, hide or show many at once.
descriptions.contests: Announcements, official rankings, rejudging and rating.
descriptions.similarity: Run a code similarity check by problem or by contest.
descriptions.rejudge: Rejudge or rescore by problem, contest, user or judge.
descriptions.judges: The list of judges, locking and disconnecting them.
descriptions.users: Ban or unban accounts and sign in as a user.
descriptions.activity: View and export logs, summaries by user.
descriptions.settings: Limits, similarity and other settings, and the change history.
descriptions.pages: Create and edit about and policy pages.
descriptions.organizations: Edit the organizations you administer, their members and join requests.
descriptions.polygonImport: Pick a problem shared on Polygon, configure it and follow the import.
descriptions.submissions: Filter submissions, select many to rejudge or recalculate points.
descriptions.contestTags: The tag catalogue shown on the contest list.
descriptions.languages: Languages submissions can use, and the judges that run them.
descriptions.shortLinks: Choose codes, set expiry and delete short links.
descriptions.integrations: Keys that let an external system create private contests and read standings.
descriptions.log: Every recorded change: who, what and when.

search.tip: Tip: press Ctrl K or / anywhere to search.
